checks.DTC2: fact candidate identity must belong to the current query packet and source map
checks.DTC3: requested period and fact period must both be known and exactly equal
checks.DTC4: explicit scope/segment conflict rejects; unknown scope is not a match
checks.DTC5: explicit statement conflict rejects when slot statement identity exists
checks.DTC6: explicit unit/currency conflict rejects; constrained unknown unit/currency is not a match
checks.DTC7: metric identity requires exact normalized canonical/structured equality; no fuzzy overlap
checks.DTC8: candidate/source physical relation must be internally valid

role_policy: operand role guides slot interpretation but is never evidence by itself
unknown_policy: unknown material evidence is not treated as a match
